name: project-brain
description: Git-native project memory and planning protocol: any coding agent, strong or weak, continues a project exactly where the last one stopped.

interface.shortDescription: Continue any project across sessions, models and vendors from the repo alone
interface.longDescription: Project Brain keeps a project's state in the repository: verified current architecture with a file map, the user's confirmed goal and target, and a prioritized task plan written so even a small model with no chat history can execute it. A local Python script computes the session state, next task and the exact files to load, so agents resume without re-scanning the codebase. Agents verify what they inherit, repair the plan only with evidence, and commit every verified step so the next session or another agent can take over.
defaultPrompt: Set up Project Brain for this repository
Continue where the last session stopped
